{"items": [
{"type": "definition", "term": "child", "text": "The term \"child\" means an individual under the age of 13."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "operator", "text": "The term \"operator\"- (A) means any person who operates a website located on the Internet or an online service and who collects or maintains personal information from or about the users of or visitors to such website or online service, or on whose behalf such information is collected or maintained, where such website or online service is operated for commercial purposes, including any person offering products or services for sale through that website or online service, involving commerce-"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Commission", "text": "The term \"Commission\" means the Federal Trade Commission."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "disclosure", "text": "The term \"disclosure\" means, with respect to personal information-"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Federal agency", "text": "The term \"Federal agency\" means an agency, as that term is defined in section 551(1) of title 5."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Internet", "text": "The term \"Internet\" means collectively the myriad of computer and telecommunications facilities, including equipment and operating software, which comprise the interconnected world-wide network of networks that employ the Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol, or any predecessor or successor protocols to such protocol, to communicate information of all kinds by wire or radio."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "parent", "text": "The term \"parent\" includes a legal guardian."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "personal information", "text": "The term \"personal information\" means individually identifiable information about an individual collected online, including-"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "section 45 of this title", "cited_instrument": "15 U.S.C. 45"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "section 551(1) of title 5", "cited_instrument": "5 U.S.C. 551(1)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol", "cited_instrument": "TCP/IP"}
]}

{"items": [{"type": "definition", "term": "verifiable parental consent", "text": "The term \"verifiable parental consent\" means any reasonable effort (taking into consideration available technology), including a request for authorization for future collection, use, and disclosure described in the notice, to ensure that a parent of a child receives notice of the operator's personal information collection, use, and disclosure practices, and authorizes the collection, use, and disclosure, as applicable, of personal information and the subsequent use of that information before that information is collected from that child."}, {"type": "definition", "term": "website or online service directed to children", "text": "The term \"website or online service directed to children\" means- (i) a commercial website or online service that is targeted to children; or (ii) that portion of a commercial website or online service that is targeted to children."}, {"type": "definition", "term": "person", "text": "The term \"person\" means any individual, partnership, corporation, trust, estate, cooperative, association, or other entity."}, {"type": "definition", "term": "online contact information", "text": "The term \"online contact information\" means an e-mail address or another substantially similar identifier that permits direct contact with a person online."}, {"type": "reference", "text": "Pub. L. 105-277", "cited_instrument": "Pub. L. 105-277 (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act of 1998)"}]}
